context:
Read adapter.py and its direct callers/importers, then document the proposed
extraction by responsibility rather than by raw line count. The map should be
concrete enough that the downstream refactor can lift one cohesive slice at a
time and know what remains intentionally in adapter.py.

The output is a working refactor map, not a design essay. Prefer tables:
symbol, line range, current responsibility, proposed module, caller risk.
description:
Quality plan Phase 2c/Phase 3 prep. The adapter-base refactor is high blast
radius, but its first slice is read-only analysis: inventory the public
surface of benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py, identify callers and cohesion
seams, and produce the extraction map that the real refactor will follow.

This TODO exists so safe analysis can begin immediately without weakening the
safety gates on quality-refactor-adapter-base-into-cohesive-modules. It
should not move code; it should make the later code-moving work smaller,
reviewable, and less likely to discover hidden coupling mid-refactor.

anti_patterns.instead: cluster by responsibility and call graph

anti_patterns.dont: start moving code in this TODO
anti_patterns.why: that would bypass the safety-gated refactor item

preserves.behavior: No adapter implementation file is modified; this item is mapping only
benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py remains code-identical in this prep TODO

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'import ast, pathlib; src = pathlib.Path("benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py").read_text(); tree = ast.parse(src); symbols = [n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and not n.name.startswith("_")]; doc = pathlib.Path("docs/development/adapter-refactor-map.md").read_text(); missing = [s for s in symbols if s not in doc]; print("MISSING:", missing) if missing else print("OK: all", len(symbols), "public symbols mapped")'
verifications.description: Refactor map enumerates every public symbol in adapter.py
verifications.expected: OK: all N public symbols mapped

verifications.description: Map references every proposed target module
adapter.py is unchanged (this TODO is read-only)

work_units.summary: Inventory adapter.py public surface: every public class, method, attribute, and mixin-style helper with line ranges and rough responsibility grouping (~3-4 hours)
Trace callers and coupling hotspots: identify which symbols are imported or overridden by platform adapters, tests, and CLI/orchestrator code (~3-4 hours)
Write docs/development/adapter-refactor-map.md with proposed module destinations, slice order, must-preserve contract, and explicit 'do not extract yet' exceptions (~2-3 hours)
